title: Evaluate an authorized narrowband station run
description:
Conduct only a specifically authorized station experiment using the approved narrowband profile, or record a documentary no-go without operating. Correlate station/operator identity, callsign/control behavior, permitted traffic and power with actual known-payload delivery and failure evidence.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Require affirmative matching narrow.06/narrow.08, authority.10 and rf.03 approvals for this session, plus explicit port and field-RF permission where relevant. Closure alone is not clearance. If denied or unsupported, keep execution blocked/deferred and report no-go without transmitting.
acceptance_criteria: Independent captures and calibrated measurements establish the tested results and identification/control performance. Apply minimum necessary power and the SS 10 W PEP ceiling where the human classification requires it. Technical results, test authority and final equipment conclusions are separately stated; no blanket range or legality claim.
